symptom: Upgrading node via nvm for a machine running pi + the context-mode gate: after installing a new version and setting the nvm default, a fresh `zsh -lic 'node -v'` still reported the OLD version, pi's bash/hypa tools still reported the old version, and the new version's global CLIs (agent-browser, argent, hypa, context-mode, vercel...) were all missing.
cause: Three separate things. (1) The calling pi process exports NVM_BIN/NVM_INC/PATH pointing at its own node version, so every child shell inherits that and masks the new nvm default — verification must use `env -i HOME=$HOME TERM=xterm PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin zsh -lic 'node -v'`, otherwise you get a false "default didn't change" reading. (2) nvm global packages are per-version, so a new node has none of them. (3) npm >= 11.20 bundled with the new node silently SKIPS install scripts on global installs (prints `npm warn install-scripts`), so native modules (better-sqlite3, node-pty, esbuild, @hypabolic/hypa-darwin-arm64, webtransport-...-quiche) install without binaries and fail at runtime.
fix: `nvm install <ver>`; reinstall globals explicitly with the allowlist flag: `npm i -g --allow-scripts=@hypabolic/pi-hypa,agent-browser,context-mode,node-pty,tree-sitter,tree-sitter-typescript,better-sqlite3,esbuild,@hypabolic/hypa-darwin-arm64,tree-sitter-javascript,protobufjs,@google/genai,@fails-components/webtransport-transport-http3-quiche <pkgs...>` (exclude npm/corepack, or npm gets downgraded); make the default track LTS with `nvm alias default "lts/*"` (verify with `nvm resolve-version "lts/*"`); ios-deploy's node-gyp/xcodebuild fails on node 26 (`** BUILD FAILED **`), so `cp -R ~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.20.0/lib/node_modules/ios-deploy ~/.nvm/versions/node/v26.13.1/lib/node_modules/ && ln -sf ../lib/node_modules/ios-deploy/build/Release/ios-deploy ~/.nvm/versions/node/v26.13.1/bin/ios-deploy`. Restart pi afterwards — the running process keeps its old node and passes it to child tools.
verify: env -i HOME=$HOME TERM=xterm PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin zsh -lic 'node -v; nvm current; npm ls -g --depth=0'
